test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Things that do not come from the ground __not safe__ to compost.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the verb agreement with the plural subject "**Things that do not come from the ground**."
 
• Plural subjects require a plural verb form.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**are not safe to compost**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Things that do not come from the ground **are not safe** to compost."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "is not safe"** – Incorrect as it does not agree with the plural subject.
 
• **Option 2: "be not safe"** – Incorrect as it is not grammatically correct in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "has not been safe"** – Incorrect as it changes the tense and meaning of the sentence.
